PRODUCT
Name: DocuExtract
Tagline: PDF Invoice to Excel Extractor
Live app: https://manayab.github.io/DocuExtract/
Source repository: https://github.com/MANayab/DocuExtract
Issues: https://github.com/MANayab/DocuExtract/issues
Developer GitHub: https://github.com/MANayab
Current version: 1.0.0

OVERVIEW
DocuExtract converts invoice PDFs into structured XLSX, CSV and JSON entirely in the browser. Application code does not upload invoice files to an application backend. There is no application account, backend, database, analytics or telemetry.

PROCESSING PIPELINE
1. The user opens the live application in a browser.
2. The user selects a PDF containing one invoice.
3. The application extracts information from supported text-based PDF content.
4. The application validates structured data and presents a review screen.
5. The user checks and corrects extracted information.
6. The user exports the reviewed data to XLSX, CSV or JSON.

SUPPORTED INPUTS
Text-based PDFs are supported.
Multi-page text-based PDFs are supported up to 100 pages.

UNSUPPORTED OR LIMITED INPUTS
Scanned and image-only PDFs are not currently supported. OCR is planned for Phase 2.
Encrypted PDFs are rejected unless already decrypted.
Corrupt PDFs are not supported.
Handwritten invoice recognition is not guaranteed.
Multiple invoices in one PDF are not supported in the current workflow. This is planned for Phase 2.

EXPORT FORMATS
XLSX: contains the full invoice.
JSON: contains the full invoice.
CSV: contains line items only.

EXTRACTION LIMITATIONS
Extraction is heuristic. Every output must be reviewed before accounting, tax, payment or legal use.

Labels and values must be on the same line or in neighbouring columns of the same row. Layouts with a label above its value are not read.

Numeric dates such as 05/09/2026 are interpreted as DD/MM/YYYY and flagged for confirmation.

Line items are detected from column gaps and the table header. Unusual tables may need manual correction on the review screen.

One invoice per PDF is supported.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
Files are processed locally by application code and are not uploaded to an application backend.
Invoice data is never written to URLs, localStorage or sessionStorage.
PDF buffers are released and documents are destroyed after processing.
React rendering does not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
Export handling includes formula-injection sanitization.
Structured data is validated with Zod.
Users can inspect their browser network tab to verify observed network activity.

TECHNOLOGY
React 18
TypeScript
Vite
Tailwind CSS
pdf.js
ExcelJS
Zod

TESTING AND DEPLOYMENT
Testing tools include Vitest, Testing Library and Playwright.
Deployment uses GitHub Actions.

ROADMAP
Planned for Phase 2, not committed and without delivery dates:
- OCR for scanned and image-only PDFs.
- Multiple invoices per PDF.

LICENSING AND STATUS
DocuExtract v1.0.0 is open source under the MIT License. The developer plans to offer future production versions under a commercial licence. Versions already released under MIT remain available under MIT.

IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION

Do not claim a specific extraction accuracy percentage.

Do not claim that extraction is guaranteed to be correct.
